transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... I guess I'm just having some trouble at work. I've gotten really... slowed down lately. Like, I'll just sit there staring at one audit workpaper for twenty minutes before I even move my hand to type. People have started noticing I'm not keeping up. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things that you usually like doing, like hobbies or activities you used to find pleasurable?

Um... yeah, I suppose. I don't really do much outside of work right now. I used to... I don't know, plan hikes, take photos. I'd cook on Sundays, or volunteer at the library sometimes. But lately... it's just... they just feel like items on a checklist. I just don't really care enough to even start them. So... yeah.
Have you been feeling like you're not good enough or blaming yourself for things lately?

Um... no, not really. I mean, obviously I know I'm not doing a great job at work right now, but... I don't really sit around blaming myself for things. I just... I don't know. I haven't really thought about it like that.
Have you been feeling like you're not worth much or that you're a burden to others lately?

Um... no, not really. I mean, I don't think so. I just... I mostly just try to keep to myself. I don't really feel like a burden, I just... I don't interact with people enough right now for that to even be a thing. So, no.
Have you been feeling tired or having a lack of energy almost every day, even when you haven't done much physically or mentally?

Um... yeah. I guess so. Even after a full night in bed... my body just feels like I've been up closing an audit for three days straight. It's just... simple things, like taking a shower or... sorting through some insurance paperwork... they just completely wipe me out. So... yeah, I'm tired.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
Um... yeah, I guess. It's just... most days I wake up and there's this... heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. It's like... the day is already lost before I've even gotten out of bed. So... yeah.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um... it's been a while. About seven months, I think. Right around the time my husband stopped working... after the downsizing. That's when it started.
Have you noticed that your movements or speech have slowed down, or that you're fidgety or restless a lot of the time?

Um... yeah, I guess I have been slower. It's... well, I'll just be sitting there at work, looking at an audit workpaper... and twenty minutes will go by before I even move my hand to type anything. It's... it's gotten bad enough that people at the office are starting to notice I'm falling behind. So... yeah, just really slowed down.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately?

Um... yeah, I guess. I don't really have much of an appetite. I mostly just... force food down because I know I should. And... my work skirts have gotten kind of loose lately. I'm not trying to lose weight or anything, it's just... yeah.
Have you had periods like this before, where you felt down and lost interest in things, or is this the first time you've felt this way?
Um... no. I don't think so. This is... I think this is the first time.
Have you ever had a period in your life before this one where you felt down and lost interest in things for more than two weeks?
Um... no. Like I just said... I don't think I've ever felt like this before. It's... it's just this time.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt unusually high, overly energetic, or extremely confident, to the point where it was out of character for you or caused problems in your life?
No... definitely not. I've never really been like that. I don't... I don't really get overly energetic or anything. So... no.
Have you ever had any other periods in your life before this one where you felt down and lost interest in things for more than two weeks?
Um... didn't you already ask me that? I... no. Like I said, I haven't. Just... just this time.
Have you ever experienced a period of time before this one, lasting at least two weeks, where you felt down or lost interest in things?
I... I don't understand why you keep asking me that. The answer is still no. I haven't.
Have you ever felt that your mood is completely unmoved by things that would usually cheer you up, like seeing friends or doing something you normally enjoy?
I guess... yeah. Nothing really helps. I don't really see friends anyway, so... it doesn't matter.
Have you ever had any other times in your life before this one, even if shorter or less severe, where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than a week or so?
I... look, this is the third time you've asked me some version of that. No. I haven't. Just... just this time. I don't know what else to tell you.
Have you ever experienced a period of feeling down or losing interest in things before this current episode, even if it was shorter or not as severe?
I... we just went over this. No. I haven't. I don't know why you keep asking me the exact same thing. It's just now.
Have you ever experienced a time before this one where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble functioning for at least two weeks in a row?
I... I don't know what you want me to say. I just told you no. The answer is still no.
Have you ever experienced a time before this one where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble functioning for at least two weeks in a row?
No. I... I really don't have a different answer for you. It's still no.
